items.title: Governing AI agent identity with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Saviynt Zuma
items.summary: AI agents authenticate, hold permissions, and act on data, yet most organizations manage them as application components rather than governed identities. Learn how Saviynt Zuma works with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to govern agents as first-class identities, from registration and least-privilege provisioning through runtime authorization, certification, and deprovisioning. Security teams can then answer which agents exist, who owns them, and what they can access.
items.creator: John Brunot
